summary: PrqCertifications manages staff certification records within a web user control context. It facilitates viewing, adding, editing, and deleting staff certifications in a grid and detail form, with roles, validations, and business rules defined for each operation.
purpose: The purpose is to allow authorized users to manage certifications related to staff members. This includes listing existing certifications, editing certification details, adding new certifications, deleting certifications, and ensuring only valid data is saved. It ensures certification workflows are tied closely to session/context and user permissions.

workflows.name: Certification List and CRUD Workflow
steps: Load certifications grid for a staff member (filtered by StaffID and UserSession)
Display Add/Edit/Delete buttons depending on ScreenIsEditable and Inactive status
Add: Switch grid to add mode, show details form
Edit: Switch grid to edit mode, load details for selected certification, show details form
Delete: Delete selected certification, update session cache, redirect to current page
Bind data to dropdowns (codes/status/expiry), set defaults for insert mode
Validate details before saving (Page.IsValid), cancel insert/update if invalid
Save: Insert/Update certification, refresh session cache and redirect

business_rules: Add/Edit/Delete actions are only available if ScreenIsEditable is true.
Inactive status affects button visibility and edit/delete capability.
UserSession must be present for data operations.
Dropdowns for CertificationCode, Status, Expiry must be populated and defaulted as needed.
Session cache must be updated after certification changes.
On insert/update, must set CertificationCodeID and StatusCodeID from dropdown values.
validations: Dropdown values must be selected for CertificationCode, Status, Expiry.
SessionID and UserSession must be present for data source operations.
ID field must match a valid UUID for update.
calculations: Effective and Expiry dates are handled by calendar controls, with MaxDate set by DateFormatter for future limit.
conditions: If UserSession is null, data source selection is cancelled.
If ScreenIsEditable is false or Disabled is true, edit fields and calendar controls are disabled.
FormView mode determines whether Insert or Update command is used.
system_behavior: Uses ScriptManager to inject JavaScript for date fields.
GridData displays certification records, manages no-data messages.
Cache is updated after certification insert/update/delete.
Redirects to same page after certification changes.
Modal popup used for detail editing.
dependencies: DropDownList controls: for certification data entry.
ObjectDataSource controls: for data access (dsStudentCertification, dsStudentCertifications, dsStatus, dsExpiryDate).
Grid and FormView: for UI display and CRUD operations.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, no data operation proceeds.
If Page.IsValid fails, insert/update is cancelled.
If ID is not a valid UUID, update will not occur.
content_gaps: Business rules around ExpiryCheck are not fully defined.
Details of calendar control behavior and MaxDate calculation are only partially described.
Exact dropdown data source content is not specified.
Validation specifics for field values are assumed based on standard FormView, not explicit in source.
